sourceConfidenceDefinition: The historical GPT Pro repair confidence field is interpreted as source_confidence, not deterministic match_confidence.

selection.duplicatePolicy: later repair manifest entries overwrite earlier repairs for the same opportunityId
selection.recommendedUse: Queue low-source-confidence records for deeper GPT Pro research or human/admin verification only while they remain potentially product-visible. Terminal unavailable or expired records are excluded from this follow-up queue.
